metadata.question: Does forest cover in the Madre de Dios region of Peru decrease in 2018 compared to 2013?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about forest cover change in Madre de Dios region of Peru between 2013 and 2018. This requires: 1. **Search Strategy**: Use Landsat imagery (Landsat 8 for 2013 onward) to calculate NDVI as a proxy for forest cover. Madre de Dios is in Peru, so I need to define a geometry for that region. 2. **Masking Strategy**: Need to mask clouds from Landsat imagery to get valid vegetation data. 3. **Logic**: Calculate mean NDVI for both years in the region. If 2018 NDVI < 2013 NDVI, then forest cover decreased (A: Yes), else (B: No). I'll use: - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance - Cloud masking using the QA band - NDVI calculation: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) - Compare mean NDVI values between the two years Let me define the geometry for Madre de Dios region in Peru and set up the analysis. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const madresDios = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-72.5, -10.0], [-68.0, -10.0], [-68.0, -13.5], [-72.5, -13.5], [-72.5, -10.0] ]); const start2013 = '2013-01-01'; const end2013 = '2013-12-31'; const start2018 = '2018-01-01'; const end2018 = '2018-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance function maskL8sr(image) { const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudsBitMask = 1 << 5; const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudsBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function getNDVI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); } // Get collections for both years const col2013 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start2013, end2013) .filterBounds(madresDios) .map(maskL8sr) .map(getNDVI); const col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start2018, end2018) .filterBounds(madresDios) .map(maskL8sr) .map(getNDVI); // Check collection sizes const size2013 = col2013.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); print(`2013 Images: ${size2013}, 2018 Images: ${size2018}`); if (size2013 === 0 || size2018 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Create median composites and calculate mean NDVI const composite2013 = col2013.median(); const composite2018 = col2018.median(); // Calculate mean NDVI with pixel count check const stats2013 = composite2013.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: madresDios, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2018 = composite2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: madresDios, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndvi2013 = stats2013.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2013 = stats2013.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const ndvi2018 = stats2018.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2018 = stats2018.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); print(`2013 NDVI: ${ndvi2013?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2013}`); print(`2018 NDVI: ${ndvi2018?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2018}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count2013 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (ndvi2013 === null || ndvi2018 === null || isNaN(ndvi2013) || isNaN(ndvi2018) || ndvi2013 > 1 || ndvi2018 > 1 || ndvi2013 < -1 || ndvi2018 < -1) { print("C3"); return; } // Final comparison - forest cover decreased if 2018 NDVI < 2013 NDVI if (ndvi2018 < ndvi2013) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
